issues.message: Legacy freezes are always appended to the active-freeze list and never passed through the LIFT cancellation check. This contradicts the documented contract that a tagged LIFT clears a legacy freeze, leaving legacy freezes permanently active.
issues.fix: Derive a deterministic scope for legacy freezes, apply later matching LIFT entries, and add a legacy FREEZE→LIFT regression test.

issues.message: The strict-actualize data-preservation guard verifies only that the section heading exists in progress.md before removing the source block; an old or partially appended block with the same heading passes while body lines may be lost. The separate instruction to move raw ideas only to backlog.md also contradicts the unconditional requirement that every removed line first exist verbatim in progress.md.
issues.fix: Append and byte-verify the complete block in progress.md before removal, then optionally copy extracted ideas to backlog.md.

issues.message: The writer accepts only FREEZE/LIFT/HANDOVER/ACK/STATUS, while the mandatory coordination workflow still requires COMMIT entries and rules/RULES.md continues to prescribe QUESTION, ANSWER, COMMIT, and ESCALATION types in the legacy heading format. Following those instructions either fails at append or creates an untyped STATUS entry.
issues.fix: Support every required protocol type in the canonical grammar or consistently redefine those events as STATUS and update all mandatory workflow references.

issues.message: Marker creation failure is ignored before returning a block decision. On an unwritable bank, later Stop calls for the same session can be blocked repeatedly, violating both the once-per-session and fail-open contracts.
issues.fix: Return allow when the marker cannot be created, and test the unwritable-marker path.

issues.message: Runtime failures from mb-status-rotate.sh are converted to warnings and prune failures other than exit 3 are discarded. The command can consequently report success or an ordinary cap overflow instead of the documented exit 2 internal error, causing the Stop hook to make a gate decision after a failed repair.
issues.fix: Propagate helper runtime failures as exit 2, preserving only the documented prune exit 3 special case.

issues.message: The compact reader emits the final N entries without any byte or line bound. One large recent entry can therefore reproduce the full 200 KB context cost despite the feature's bounded-summary goal; the test covers a large board only when every tail entry is small.
issues.fix: Apply a documented total output cap with an explicit truncation marker and add a test containing one oversized tail entry.

issues.message: Legacy freeze detection checks only that a line contains any `**` token and separately contains FREEZE REQUEST or ⚠️ FREEZE. It does not prove that the freeze marker itself is bold, so text such as `**Note:** the prior FREEZE REQUEST is obsolete` becomes an active legacy freeze.
issues.fix: Match the marker inside an actual bold span and add negative tests where unrelated text is bold.

issues.message: The rotation test labels sections 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-06 in ascending order but asserts that 2026-09-06 is archived and 2026-09-01 remains. This proves preservation of the oldest sections, contradicting the documented requirement to retain the newest three.
issues.fix: Order the fixture according to the real status convention and assert that dates 2026-09-04 through 2026-09-06 remain while older sections are archived.
